"A cramped yet reliable shuttle for providing official janitorial services. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries."
# Tips on running LVHI Brigand shuttles - Optimal [bold]Target Power[/bold] (kW) for the generator unit is [color=#a4885c]8 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]. If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Электроснабжение" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Предполётная проверка" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - There are two buttons in the cockpit: the one with a yellow and black frame controls the window shutters. The button with the gray frame toggles the thrusters and gyroscope.
- For the basics of [bold]janitorial work[/bold], refer to [textlink="Уборка" link="Janitorial"]. - For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Пилотирование" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Топология сектора" link="SectorTopology"/]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Наём экипажа" link="Hiring"] for more information.
